heroLead: From Keta, Ghana to Salisbury, North Carolina
heroBody: I grew up in Keta, a town on Ghana's coast that the sea has been taking back for decades. That taught me a good question is only worth something if the answer reaches the people living with the problem.

Today I study Computer Science with a minor in Mathematics at Livingstone College. As a researcher I use machine learning and statistics to find out what is true. As an engineer I turn those findings into software people open.

experience.body: Analyzed 28K+ CDC survey records in R to find demographic predictors of youth e-cigarette use. Our project won best research of 49 teams at AUCC PFx.
Built an LSTM flood-risk classifier on 12 years of weather and geospatial data, reaching 93% accuracy. Engineered Earth Engine pipelines for 18 risk indicators.
Found the high-value customer segments behind a 45% sales lift in six months. Built Power BI dashboards and automated reporting that used to take five hours.
